name: setup: superadmin login works on the second instance
setup: tenant created, admin can log in
setup: plain Doer employee created and can log in
AI assistant is OFF by default for a new tenant (403 AI_ASSISTANT_DISABLED)
superadmin can enable the AI assistant for a tenant and set a monthly limit
a normal tenant admin token cannot flip the AI assistant switch (superadmin-only)
with no model configured (no API key, no fake model), the assistant degrades gracefully (503) instead of crashing
create_task via the assistant returns needsConfirmation with a plain-language summary, and does NOT execute yet
confirming the staged create_task actually runs it (200)
the task really was created after confirmation (doer task count went up by exactly 1)
created task is assigned to the doer the user actually named, not a guessed one
a confirmId cannot be replayed a second time (expired/invalid)
approve_payroll is refused outright and the user is told which screen to open, even though the model tried to call it
even when the model is fooled by injected text into trying a forbidden action, the executor still blocks it unconditionally (not relying on the model behaving)
an ambiguous write request (no explicit date given) gets a clarifying question back, not a guessed write
list_my_tasks as the Doer succeeds and only returns their own tasks (the assistant used their token, not an admin one)
per-user rate limiting kicks in after enough rapid requests
a tiny monthly usage cap is enforced once exceeded
